text:
Adrian Kempe had a hat trick against San Jose that moved him past Dustin Brown on the Kings' franchise list, and he's one of the reasons Los Angeles is better than its 5-9-2 record. The Kings take 59% of the expected goals at five on five with him on the ice, 14 points better than without him.

The points (13 in 15 games) lag the play. He's shooting 12% against a typical 14, and the Kings have scored about four fewer goals than expected with him out there. Both should help him from here. It's a change from last season, when Evolving-Hockey had him giving up more chances than almost any forward (bottom 5%) and paying for penalties.

He scored 36 goals last season, all of his career in Los Angeles. With Kevin Fiala back, the Kings finally have another finisher beside him. Our range has him at 26 to 42 goals.
